name: economy_rules
pages: There is no way to buy gold from Blizzard in WoW: Forever.
Blizzard confirmed at its Sept 17 developer Q&A that gold-bid loot runs aren't allowed.
Blizzard says GDKP makes raiding harder to join for new players and pushes people to buy gold.
Announced Oct 13. A flagged account loses trade, mail, guild bank and Auction House while Blizzard investigates.
Buyers and sellers of illicit gold can both be flagged.
The hold lifts automatically and leaves no permanent strike.
Blizzard says it will punish gold buyers aggressively, up to permanent account loss.
All three capitals of a faction share one Auction House (per ConquestCapped).
Only at the neutral houses in Gadgetzan, Booty Bay and Everlook, which take 15% instead of 5%.
Mister Graphed at the Black Market in the Riverglades sells rare reagents like Black Lotus at a fixed price.
Since Nov 10, most quests level 48 and up also reward gold.
